One fix to 1.10.0, found in its first minutes on a live machine.

To update, run the new `dpiswitch.exe` from anywhere and accept the offer to install over the installed version (one administrator prompt). Settings, lists, configs and verdicts are kept.

## Detector

- **A QUIC check the tunnel's side failed refuses no QUIC.** A name going direct with the ClientHello cut had its QUIC refused whenever its QUIC check came out anything but clean -- one where the tunnel did not answer among them, after which the decoy is not even tried. 1.10.0 checks such names on the QUIC they are seen on, and ten seconds after a restart a name was refused, for a week, the QUIC the decoy gets through. Such a check says nothing of the name's QUIC now and refuses nothing; a host with no QUIC on either path is refused as before.

A name refused so by 1.10.0 keeps the mark until its verdict is checked again: dropping the verdict on the Verdicts page has it checked at once.

Core: the fork's 8067c742 (mihomo Alpha 9f053c49).
